batches.reason: User-authorized rerun of failures whose cause is a timeout. Each task carries an existing canonical verdict (failed) from run 35992545942, so this batch is a variance probe only and can never replace or reinterpret those verdicts. Mechanical classification of the timeout: every one of the four attempts ended on AgentTimeoutError at its own official agent budget (946s/900s, 1236s/1200s, 938s/900s, 928s/900s) while the agent was still iterating, and the frozen attempt evidence contains zero model-failure entries (chess-best-move 36/36 model requests answered, code-from-image 32 req/31 out, gcode-to-text 45 req/44 out, largest-eigenval 40 req/39 out). The agent was killed at the budget boundary, not by a provider transport or connection failure. The same four tasks also hit their official budget on the previous full run 35810093521 (candidate 0953e901), so the timeout is chronic across candidates rather than a one-off. The official agent budget is preserved (fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1); it is never extended to convert a budget outcome into a pass.
